name: Resistance

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Touch willing creature; choose damage type from eleven source-listed types; once per turn reduce that type by 1d4 for Concentration; no save bonus or blanket Resistance.

rules.text: You touch a willing creature and choose a damage type: Acid, Bludgeoning, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Piercing, Poison, Radiant, Slashing, or Thunder.
When the creature takes damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, the creature reduces the total damage taken by 1d4.
A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.
